Adjustment.description: A signed, labelled amount added to the free cash flow of a period.

label.description: What the amount is, for example "Disposal of a warehouse". Not empty.

value.description:
Amount in currency units: positive for an inflow (for example proceeds from a disposal),
negative for an outflow.

FirstTerminalFlow.description: The flow at N + 1 of a technique that grows the last explicit flow (R20).

oneOf.description: CF_{N+1} = CF_N × (1 + g), the last explicit flow grown by the perpetual growth.

FreeCashFlowLines.description: The line items of one period, after reclassification (SPEC-0005).

capital_expenditure.description:
Capital expenditure of the period, in currency units, zero or more; subtracted.
Disposals go in `other_adjustments` with a positive sign.

change_in_net_working_capital.description:
Change in net working capital of the period, in currency units: positive for an
increase, which absorbs cash and is subtracted; negative for a decrease.

depreciation_and_amortisation.description: Depreciation and amortisation of the period, in currency units, zero or more; added back.

ebit.description: EBIT (earnings before interest and taxes) of the period, in currency units; any sign.

interest_expense.description:
Interest expense of the period, in currency units, zero or more. Give it with
`net_borrowing`, for every period or for none, to obtain the FCFE. Default: none.

net_borrowing.description:
Net borrowing of the period, in currency units: positive for new borrowing, negative for
net repayment. Give it with `interest_expense`. Default: none.

operating_taxes.description:
Taxes on EBIT of the period, in currency units, positive for a tax paid (amounts form).
Give it for every period and omit `notional_tax_rate`, or omit it everywhere and give
`notional_tax_rate`. Default: none.

other_adjustments.description:
Other labelled adjustments, each positive for an inflow and negative for an outflow.
Default: none.

GordonTerminal.description:
The terms of `tv.gordon` inside the DCF: the rate is the terminal rate of the DCF and the
last flow is the last explicit flow.

growth.description:
Perpetual growth after the horizon, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1 and
below the terminal rate, in the terms of the cash flows.

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none,
reported as absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused.

normalised_next_flow.description:
The flow at N + 1 in currency units, in the terms of the cash flows; required with
`first_flow` = `normalised_next_flow`, refused otherwise.

Line.description: A labelled amount, for example an asset and its realisable value.

label.description: What the amount is, for example "Land" or "Bank loan". Not empty.

value.description: Amount in currency units, zero or positive.

NegativeEbit.description: Tax on a negative EBIT when the taxes are computed from a rate (SPEC-0001 R4).

oneOf.description: Taxes = rate × EBIT also when EBIT is negative: a tax saving that raises the flow.
No tax when EBIT is negative.

NetFinancialPosition.description:
The net financial position with its composition (SPEC-0007 R6). Fairmark adds what is
given and does not choose which items are included.

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents, in currency units, subtracted from the gross debt.

gross_debt.description: Gross financial debt (bank loans, bonds and other borrowings), in currency units.

other_items.description: Other items included by the analyst, each added with its sign. Default: none.

NfpItem.description: One item of the net financial position other than gross debt and cash.

amount.description:
Amount in currency units, added to the net financial position: positive for debt-like
items, negative for financial assets.

name.description: What the item is, for example "lease liabilities" or "derivative assets".

Projection.description: How the flows of a stage are obtained (Decision 3).

oneOf.description:
The flows are given, one per period, in `flows`, or built up from line items in
`lines` (exactly one of the two).
Each flow is the previous flow × (1 + `growth`).

The growth moves from `from_growth` to `to_growth` in equal steps,
g_k = g_from + (g_to − g_from) × k / m, reaching `to_growth` in the last period
(Decision 4).

Stage.description:
One explicit stage: a number of periods and how its flows are obtained. Each projection
takes only its own fields: `flows` or `lines` for `given`, `growth` for `constant_growth`,
`from_growth` and `to_growth` for `linear_decline`.

flows.description:
For `given`: the flows of the stage in currency units, exactly one per period, in the
terms of `cash_flow_terms`.

from_growth.description:
For `linear_decline`: the growth before the stage, decimal fraction per period, greater
than -1.

growth.description: For `constant_growth`: growth per period, decimal fraction, greater than -1.

lines.description:
For `given`, instead of `flows`: the line items of each period (EBIT, taxes on EBIT,
depreciation and amortisation, capital expenditure, change in net working capital,
adjustments), exactly one per period, in currency units in the terms of
`cash_flow_terms`; the flow of each period is built up as in `dcf.free_cash_flows`, with
the tax fields of the method (SPEC-0001 R7).

periods.description: Number of periods of the stage, at least 1; one period is one year.

to_growth.description:
For `linear_decline`: the growth of the last period of the stage, decimal fraction per
period, greater than -1.

Terminal.description:
The terminal technique, written as an object with exactly one key, the `tv.*` method id,
as in `tv.compare`: `{"tv.gordon": {...}}`.

TerminalDiscountTime.description: When the terminal value is discounted under mid-period timing (Decision 6).

oneOf.description: At the horizon, t = N: factor DF_N.
Half a period earlier, t = N − 0.5: factor DF_N × (1 + r_N)^0.5.

Terms.description: Whether amounts and growth rates, or discount rates, include expected inflation.

oneOf.description: At current prices: expected inflation included.
At constant prices: expected inflation excluded.

Timing.description:
When cash flows arrive within each period.

Rates are always decimal fractions per period: `0.10` means 10%.

oneOf.description: Cash flows at the end of each period (t = 1, 2, ..., n).
Cash flows spread evenly, discounted at mid period (t = 0.5, 1.5, ...).

description: Input of `dcf.fcff` (version 3). Every choice is required, with no default (R29).

base_flow.description:
FCFF of the base period CF_0, in currency units: required when the first stage is
`constant_growth` or `linear_decline`, refused when it is `given`.

cash_flow_terms.description: `nominal` or `real`: the terms of every amount and growth rate of the input.

discount_rate_terms.description:
`nominal` or `real`: the terms of the discount rates. They must equal
`cash_flow_terms`.

negative_ebit.description:
For stages with `lines` and `notional_tax_rate`: treatment of a negative EBIT, `credit`
(taxes = rate × EBIT) or `zero` (no tax); required with `notional_tax_rate`, no default.

net_financial_position.description:
Net financial position at the valuation date (SPEC-0007): gross debt − cash + signed
other items, positive for net debt, subtracted from enterprise value. Default: none,
reported.

non_operating_assets.description:
Non-operating assets at the valuation date, each a label and a value in currency units
(zero or more), added to the value of operations. Default: none, reported.

notional_tax_rate.description:
For stages with `lines`: tax rate applied to EBIT, decimal fraction from 0 to below 1
(0.24 = 24%). Give this, or `operating_taxes` in every line, not both; refused when no
stage has `lines`. Default: none.

stages.description:
One to three explicit stages, in order; the explicit horizon N is the sum of their
periods. Each stage is `{"periods", "projection", ...}` with the fields of its
projection.

terminal.description:
The terminal technique, an object with exactly one key, the method id:
`{"tv.gordon": {"growth", "first_flow", ...}}`, on the enterprise basis.

terminal_discount_time.description:
With `mid_period` timing, required: `horizon` (terminal value at t = N) or
`mid_period` (t = N − 0.5). Refused with `end_of_period`.

terminal_wacc.description:
WACC of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period; required with
`wacc_per_period`, refused with `wacc`.

timing.description: `end_of_period` (flow k at t = k) or `mid_period` (t = k − 0.5); no default.

wacc.description:
One WACC for every period and for the terminal value, decimal fraction per period
(0.09 = 9%), greater than -1. Give this or `wacc_per_period`, not both.

wacc_per_period.description:
One WACC per period of the explicit horizon, decimal fractions, exactly N of them;
requires `terminal_wacc`. Give this or `wacc`, not both.

title: DcfFcffInput
